meta.title: Pricing: who pays what, when | IGUDAR
meta.description: The IGUDAR fee grid, published in full: who pays what, and when.

hero.title: One fee for you, the rest inside the company
hero.lead: You pay one fee yourself: a structuring fee of {rate} + VAT when you subscribe ({fee} on {ticket}). Everything else is taken inside the property company before you are paid.
hero.beta: Closed beta, approved by hand. A prototype with demo money only: nothing is invested.

individual.title: Individual
individual.audience: For one person investing on their own.

plans.insideCompany: The platform fee is paid by the property company out of the rent, before your payouts. You do not pay it separately.

fees.transfer: Transfer, only if you sell early

figures.totalGain: Total gain after the sale over {years} years

plans.footnote: Simulation net of fees and taxes, not guaranteed: Base scenario of the IGUDAR financial model, sold after {years} years; the IRR includes the sale; total gain = net rent + sale proceeds − everything you paid in (amount invested + structuring fee). Pessimistic shown beside Base.

table.title: Who pays what, when
table.caption: Who pays what, when, and what it means at {ticket}

S1.label: Syndication
S1.paidBy: Seller / developer, only if the raise closes

rate.D5: {rate} of the gain above a {hurdle}/yr hurdle

table.note: The last column is worked out for {ticket}, the minimum ticket. HT means before VAT; TTC includes the {tva} VAT that the property company cannot recover.

notPaid.title: What you pay, and what you don't

syndication.title: Sellers pay the syndication fee
syndication.text: {rate} of the capital raised, charged to the seller or developer, and only if the raise closes.

company.title: Everything else is inside the property company
company.text: The platform fee ({rate} a year), the exit fee ({exit}) and the performance fee ({performance} above {hurdle} a year) are taken inside the property company before you are paid.

entry.title: One fee, paid by you
entry.text: A structuring fee of {rate} + VAT when you subscribe: {fee} on {ticket}. It is shown before you pay.

notPaid.footnote: A transfer fee of {transfer} applies only if you sell your share early, and the seller pays it. Seller fees never reduce your return. Fees are a disclosed service charge, never netted against a promised yield.
